name: Chrome and Safari Web Font Rendering Fix
author: TheIToons

sections.description:
This plugin includes a simple JavaScript snippet that helps your pages display local fonts while external fonts load in the background. Prevents font flicker and improves user experience, especially for Chrome/Safari users.

Features

  • Prevents font flickering.
  • Fixes Chrome/Safari rendering bugs.
  • Lightweight and plug-and-play.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin archive (.zip) to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Extract it.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  4. That’s it! No further settings required.
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

It adds a JavaScript snippet that ensures local fonts are displayed until external web fonts are ready. This prevents blank font rendering issues in some browsers.

Do I need to configure anything?

No configuration needed. Just activate and forget!
sections.changelog:
1.0

  • First release. Solves font rendering issues with Chrome/Safari.
